title: Mei and the Dragon Who Feared Thunder
subtitle: One Dry Spring, One Shy Dragon and One Very Small Voice
blurb: For 114 days no rain has fallen on Bamboo Ridge Village, and eleven-year-old Mei, who freezes whenever she has to speak up, is the only one who will climb the mountain to ask the old rain dragon for help. But the dragon has a secret: he is terrified of his own thunder.
